name: moonfish-original-short-clock
notes: Unchanged source uses the host online CPU count,1024 node expansions per worker per batch, and a dynamically reallocating shared tree. A1 GiB engineering working-set budget plus512 MiB reserve and4 GiB AS is intended for short probes on at most32 online CPUs with default stack no greater than8 MiB. No hard tree-size theorem is claimed. Larger hosts require a new justified budget; this condition never changes their worker count. Original unxz deployment is independently known to fail.
Copy this template outside the repository and bind artifact to the actual external file before resource plan. Only paths are hydration parameters; the original SHA and settings remain pinned.

Planning is read-only. Explicit --start rechecks inputs, tools and current resources; insufficient resources remain blocked. No allocation probe, Hash/Threads change, CPU restriction or parent limit increase is used.
